result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends mainly on where your business operates, how many employees you have, and whether you already use accounting software.

**My general recommendation\:** choose software that automates payroll calculations, tax deductions, payslips, pension contributions and year-end reporting. Saving a little on monthly fees isn't worth creating extra admin or compliance headaches.

If you're based in the UK, I'd shortlist **Xero Payroll, Sage Payroll, BrightPay and QuickBooks Payroll** rather than automatically choosing popular US products such as Gusto.

## Best payroll software for UK small businesses

Here are the options I'd consider in 2026\:

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Standalone payroll solution.
- HMRC submissions and pension auto-enrolment.
- Good for growing businesses.
- Indicative price: from £12/month.
  
  Best if you want payroll without needing a particular accounting platform.
  
  [Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll)

- Designed specifically for payroll.
- Strong pension and statutory payment features.
- Useful for accountants and small employers.
- Pricing depends on employee numbers.
  
  [BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll**

(Best for existing Xero users)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- Employee payslips and HMRC reporting.
- Good bookkeeping integration.
- Payroll availability depends on your subscription.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Good accounting and payroll integration.
- PAYE and pension functionality.
- Convenient if you already use QuickBooks.
  
  [QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

**5\. Employment Hero**

## What I'd compare before buying

Make sure your chosen software supports\:

- PAYE and National Insurance calculations.
- Real Time Information (RTI) submissions to HMRC.
- Workplace pension auto-enrolment.
- Payslips, P45s and P60s.
- Statutory sick pay and maternity pay.
- Holiday pay and employee records.

You can also check the official [HMRC-recognised payroll software list](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-payroll-software-that-is-recognised-by-hmrc?utm_source=chatgpt.com)\.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
